verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test account isolated from production data is a fair question for an observability SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no New Relic sandbox environment. The closest items do not qualify: the free tier is a pricing plan, nr1 nerdpack:serve is a local development server for UI apps, and the NerdGraph API explorer queries live account data. Monitoring separate QA/staging environments is a user-side arrangement and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
